newsitem.title: GERMANY: Mannesmann says Jan-Feb sales, order up.
newsitem.headline: Mannesmann says Jan-Feb sales, order up.

text.p: Mannesmann AG, the German industrial and telecommunications group, said on Wednesday that sales were up sharply in the first two months of 1997, spurred by improvements in the economy.
Mannesmann chairman Joachim Funk said sales in January and February rose 13 percent to 5.1 billion marks and orders surged 19 percent to 6.8 billion marks.
"Mannesmann is feeling the first clear signs of an improvement in investment," Funk said. "The launch into 1997 was good. This makes us confident for the full year."
Funk attributed the strong growth at the beginning of the year to growth in telecommunications and positive developments in the engineering sector.
He said telecommunications sales at Mannesmann would cross the five billion mark threshold for the first time this year.
"Deutsche Telekom is bigger than us but we are growing faster," Funk said of competitor Telekom, the German national telephone monopoly.
